summary: Server discloses information about the application (e.g. title, content-length) in the response headers.

remediation.config_change: Remove GET /health from production builds or require an administrator session; never serialize configuration values into responses; move secrets to an injected secret store so they cannot appear in any dump.

validation.note: ground truth does not mark this path as requiring authentication

remediation.config_change: Require an authenticated session (and the appropriate role) on GET /; register the check in shared middleware so new routes inherit it; return 401 without credentials and 403 for the wrong role.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@rx ^/" "id:9100005,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay auth-missing virtual patch f-31dacfe2d01d5c0a',tag:'assay/auth-missing'"
{"class":"auth-missing","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-31dacfe2d01d5c0a","id":9100005,"rule":"SecRule REQUEST_URI \"@rx ^/\" \"id:9100005,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay auth-missing virtual patch f-31dacfe2d01d5c0a',tag:'assay/auth-missing'\""}

summary: Default credentials exposed in login endpoint

validation.note: documented default credential accepted for admin

remediation.config_change: Remove or rotate the seeded default credential; force a password change on first login; enforce a minimum password policy and lock the account after repeated failures on GET /login.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:* "@pmFromFile default-passwords.txt" "id:9100007,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay default-creds virtual patch f-5a39fbf6f16c4ec7',tag:'assay/default-creds'"
{"class":"default-creds","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-5a39fbf6f16c4ec7","id":9100007,"rule":"SecRule ARGS:* \"@pmFromFile default-passwords.txt\" \"id:9100007,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay default-creds virtual patch f-5a39fbf6f16c4ec7',tag:'assay/default-creds'\""}

remediation.config_change: Remove the file served at /health from the web root; block dotfiles, backups and dumps at the server (deny .git, .env, *.sql, *.bak); store backups outside any served directory.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@rx (?i)\.(?:sql|bak|env|git|old|zip|tar\.gz)(?:$|\?)" "id:9100018,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay sensitive-file virtual patch f-bda6fb4c0225a71d',tag:'assay/sensitive-file'"

summary: Login page contains a reflected XSS vulnerability, which can be exploited by attackers to inject and execute arbitrary HTML/JS

remediation.config_change: HTML-escape <parameter> before writing it into the page for GET /login (html/template or the framework's auto-escaping renderer); send Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 and a Content-Security-Policy without 'unsafe-inline'.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:* "@detectXSS" "id:9100002,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,msg:'assay xss-reflected virtual patch f-fd046096c6ea825b',tag:'assay/xss-reflected'"
